candidate_decisions.decision: Use VARCHAR public columns in V1, including exact decimal text and nullable boolean spellings; preserve literal fields separately. Do not introduce DOUBLE rounding or percentage conversion.
Retain ordered JSON arrays for repeated periods and legislative references in V1; preserve raw publisher strings and per-reference locators. Downstream links identify the reference occurrence.

Publisher IDs retain their raw names. Adapters version deterministic local keys derived from full source identity context; duplicate or ambiguous keys refuse an update. Row position alone is not stable identity.
Record source-model fit, acquisition completeness, parser qualification and score-reproduction readiness separately. An opaque rating may be publishable without a reconstructable calculation.

Replace only complete publisher-defined editions or explicitly separate complete chamber editions; preserve failed and absent historical scopes. A publisher-declared House-only scope is valid; a failed Senate read is not.

Keep SpicyDocs source facts and table definitions distinct from SpicyRegs resolution and publication. Test the actual pinned wheel integration before qualification; exclude unrelated local changes from any new package.

accepted_design_rules: Keys contain nonempty strings; identities are unique before merge and versioned per adapter. Row offset alone is not durable identity.

Exactly one accepted snapshot per edition in a family generation, every fact snapshot matches its edition, every fact capture belongs to its snapshot, and all references stay within the selected snapshot.
Member-item metric_id and participation_id are both null or both nonempty. No metric is created merely to store an item result.
Item-level targets require source-stated context and locator. Metric-specific targets live on metric participation; do not infer one from the other.
Metric components form an acyclic directed graph. Primary metrics are scoped by chamber/cohort/period.
Selected source rendition and identity rules are recorded per snapshot. Literal display values are not converted to agree with corroborating captures.
Source action labels never imply an official action. Preserve publisher-specific semantic rules, including AFL-CIO no-means-signed letter encoding.
Schema fit, acquisition completeness, parser qualification and reproduction readiness are independent statuses.
Rolling editions use a source-defined live edition identity; refresh changes snapshot. Relative windows remain literal until publisher endpoints are supplied.
